insights.headline: Gold steadies near $3,730 after dipping below $3,700
insights.summary: Spot gold rose to $3,733.76 an ounce on Thursday after touching $3,693.13, its lowest since September 2025, as hawkish Fed minutes and a stronger dollar weighed; silver rose to $45.38. MCX December gold traded near Rs 1,29,650 per 10 g and silver near Rs 1,61,661 per kg, with markets pricing about a 90% chance of a quarter-point Fed hike in December.
points: Spot gold rose 0.3% to $3,733.76 an ounce after touching $3,693.13, its lowest since September 2025; StoneX called it likely bear profit-taking.
MCX gold traded near Rs 1,29,650 per 10 g and silver near Rs 1,61,661 per kg on Thursday morning.
Gold is down about 33.5% and silver nearly 63% from January record highs; silver would need about a 170% rally to reclaim its peak.
CME FedWatch priced about a 90% chance of a quarter-point December Fed hike, with a 10% chance of a half-point move.
Festive gold sales value rose 15-25% year-on-year, the World Gold Council said, while volumes were largely flat.

brief.headline: Gold steadies near $3,700 as Iran tensions lift prices
brief.summary: Spot gold held near $3,700 and MCX gold traded around Rs 1,30,200 per 10 g as Iran tensions offset hawkish Fed signals.

bullets.text: Fed minutes showed almost all officials saw more hikes ahead, lifting the dollar and yields, while Iran tensions gave gold some support.
The rupee stayed at 93.44 per dollar as FII inflows offset importer demand, while festive gold sales value rose 15-25% despite high prices.
Next on the calendar: the Fed's December 8-9 meeting, with markets pricing about a 90% chance of a quarter-point hike.

trending.title: Fed hike bets keep bullion under pressure
trending.summary: Hawkish Fed minutes and officials' comments lifted the dollar and yields, keeping gold near a 14-month low; markets price about a 90% chance of a quarter-point December hike.

trending.title: Silver steadies after a steeper fall
trending.summary: Silver rose 0.8% to $45.38 after slipping to a 14-month low of $44.54, with MCX silver rebounding to Rs 1,61,661 per kg; the metal is down about 63% from its January record high.

trending.title: Festive demand holds up despite high prices
trending.summary: Festive gold sales value rose 15-25% year-on-year, the World Gold Council said, while the price correction may support jewellery demand during India's wedding season.

trending.title: India's import bill shrinks as prices bite
trending.summary: Gold imports may fall to $40 billion in FY27 as the duty hike curbs demand, the Commerce Secretary said; October imports tripled to $5.51 billion but remain well below historical levels.

trending.title: Central banks still buying on dips
trending.summary: Central banks are rethinking gold as global risks mount, even as prices correct from January's record highs.

items.title: $3,700 breached: Gold sellers extend control on hawkish Fed outlook
items.summary: Gold slipped below $3,700 an ounce early on Thursday, the first breach in 14 months, as a firm dollar and hawkish Fed signals kept sellers in control. Fed Governor Waller said the central bank should raise rates by 50 basis points in December or signal faster hikes in 2027. Spot gold traded near $3,715, below all major moving averages.

items.title: Gold edges up from 14-month low as markets assess Fed rate outlook
items.summary: Spot gold rose 0.3% to $3,733.76 an ounce by 0630 GMT on Thursday after touching $3,693.13, its lowest since September 2025, as traders weighed hawkish Fed signals; markets price a 90% chance of a 25-basis-point December hike and 10% for a half-point move, while silver rose 0.8% to $45.38.

items.title: Gold trades near $3,730 after briefly dipping below $3,700 on hawkish Fed signals
items.summary: Spot gold traded near $3,730 an ounce on Thursday after briefly slipping below $3,700, its lowest since September 2025, as a stronger dollar and hawkish Fed minutes weighed. Silver recovered to about $45.43 after dropping below $45, while markets priced about a 90% chance of a quarter-point Fed hike in December and a 10% chance of a half-point move.

items.title: Gold Steadies Near 14-Month Low as Fed Signals More Rate Hikes
items.summary: Gold steadied near a 14-month low after hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials reinforced expectations for interest-rate hikes stretching into next year, Bloomberg reported. Spot gold held near $3,730 after briefly dipping below $3,700, its lowest since September 2025.

items.title: Gold and silver price on Nov 19: MCX gold trades in red at ₹1.29 lakh per 10 gm, Silver edges 1% higher
items.summary: MCX December gold traded 0.13% lower at ₹1,29,650 per 10 g on Thursday morning, below the ₹1.30 lakh mark, while December silver rose 0.5% to ₹1,61,661 per kg from its previous close of ₹1,60,734.

items.title: MCX Gold trades below ₹1.30 lakh per 10 gram, Silver price falls below ₹1.6 lakh per kg; check trade setup for Nov 19
items.summary: MCX December gold futures traded near ₹1,29,274 per 10 g and silver near ₹1,60,600 per kg in the afternoon session, with spot gold around $3,733 an ounce and silver near $45.01, as a firm dollar and Fed hike bets kept the metals under pressure. Gold held just above support at ₹1,28,412, with resistance at ₹1,38,249.

items.title: Gold (XAUUSD) & Silver Price Forecast: Gold Stuck Near 14-Month Low as Fed Hike Bets Build, Can $3,707 Hold?
items.summary: Gold held near its lowest since September 2025 at about $3,735, with support at $3,690 and resistance at $3,820, FXEmpire said, as CME FedWatch priced a 90% chance of a quarter-point December hike and a 10% chance of a half-point move. Silver traded near $45.39, below its $45.70 pivot.

items.title: Gold falls to Rs 130,200/10 grams, silver plunges to Rs 161,054/kg, sharp downslide continues on MCX
items.summary: MCX gold was trading around Rs 1,30,200 per 10 g and silver around Rs 1,61,054 per kg, extending a slide that has run for 15 straight sessions on profit booking, a stronger dollar and Fed rate-hike concerns. In Nagpur's Itwari Sarafa market, gold was Rs 1,31,000 per 10 g and silver Rs 1,63,000 per kg.

items.title: Gold plunges below $3,750, silver tumbles as hawkish Fed minutes pressure metals
items.summary: Spot gold fell 3.3% to $3,722.60 an ounce, its lowest since September 2025, and silver slid 5% to $44.93 after the Fed's October minutes reinforced expectations of more rate hikes. Governor Waller raised a possible half-point December move, the dollar held near a 19-month high and the 10-year yield stayed above 5%, while US housing data pointed to weakness.

items.title: Gold drops to 14-month low as dollar, yields rise on hawkish Fed rhetoric
items.summary: Spot gold sank 3.2% to $3,726 an ounce, its lowest since September 2025, after the Fed's October minutes showed most officials see further rate hikes and Governor Waller backed a possible half-point December rise. US gold futures settled at $3,741.90, silver slid 5% to $45.03 and platinum fell 4.1%, as the dollar hit a 19-month high.

items.title: Gold Rebounds as Iran Tensions Escalate, but $3,667 Support Faces a Test
items.summary: Gold rebounded as tensions with Iran escalated, Investing.com reported, though the $3,667 level remains a key support to watch after the slide to a 14-month low.

items.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD languishes around $45.00 amid Fed hiking bets
items.summary: Silver consolidated near $45 an ounce after touching a fresh 14-month low of $44.54, staying on the defensive as the dollar rallied on hawkish Fed minutes and Governor Waller's remarks reviving talk of a larger December hike. Analysts at ING said the market has got the message that the Fed needs to take rates higher to bring inflation back to target.

items.title: Why gold, silver prices are going down? What experts say about rate fall - More plunge ahead or bounce back expected?
items.summary: Gold and silver futures fell for a fourth straight session on Thursday, pressured by a stronger dollar, rising Treasury yields and expectations of more Fed rate hikes. MCX December gold was down 0.15% at ₹1,29,625 per 10 g at 11:30 am, while silver recovered 0.79% to ₹1,62,000 per kg. Experts cited the dollar index near 103.4 and markets pricing about a 92% chance of a December hike.

items.title: Gold needs 50% rally to reclaim record high, silver needs 170%: Which metal offers better risk-reward?
items.summary: Gold is down about 33.5% and silver nearly 63% from their January record highs, so gold would need roughly a 50% rally and silver about 170% to reclaim them, Moneycontrol reports. Augmont's Renisha Chainani said the risk-reward has shifted in favour of gold for now, with central-bank buying supporting it, while silver suits patient investors who buy in stages.

items.title: Gold futures slide near Rs 1.29 lakh, silver below Rs 1.60 lakh on MCX amid hawkish Fed signals: Should investors buy the dip?
items.summary: MCX December gold futures opened 0.75% lower at Rs 1,28,842 per 10 g and silver slipped to Rs 1,59,960 per kg in early trade, as a firmer dollar, rising yields and hawkish Fed commentary kept pressure on bullion. Spot gold hovered just above $3,711 an ounce and silver near $45, with cross-asset selling as a tech-led equity correction forces liquidation.

items.title: Silver at the Reversal Crossroads: Is the November Selloff Approaching Exhaustion?
items.summary: Silver's November selloff may be approaching exhaustion, Investing.com's analysis said, as the metal steadies after its steep fall from record highs.

items.title: Silver Bears Eye $35: At That Price, 1-Kg Silver May Cost Less Than 10 Gm Of Gold In India
items.summary: Technical analysts warn silver could slide towards $35 an ounce; with gold near $3,765, that would lift the gold-silver ratio to its highest since 2020 and make 1 kg of silver cheaper than 10 gm of gold on MCX.

items.title: Silver gets ₹24,000/kg cheaper in 1 week: Gold prices fall ₹12,000/10 gm in as many days
items.summary: Gold has become about Rs 12,000 cheaper per 10 g and silver about Rs 24,000 cheaper per kg over seven trading sessions, IBJA data shows, with 24-carat gold at Rs 1.30 lakh per 10 g and silver at Rs 1.62 lakh per kg on November 19. IBJA puts silver's January 29 high at Rs 3.80 lakh per kg, Rs 2.18 lakh above today's level.

items.title: Gold was at Rs 1.81 lakh at the start of 2026, and now it has crashed almost 29% to Rs 1.29 lakh per 10 g
items.summary: Gold has crashed almost 29% from Rs 1.81 lakh per 10 g at the start of 2026 to about Rs 1.29 lakh, the Times of India reported. MCX gold futures edged down Rs 44 to Rs 1,29,770 per 10 g on Thursday as spot demand stayed subdued, while international gold held near $3,740 an ounce.

items.title: Silver's sharp correction brings buyers back to the market
items.summary: Silver's steep correction — down nearly 57% to about ₹1.7 lakh per kg from January's ₹4 lakh record — is bringing buyers back for coins, bars and smaller denominations, jewellers say, with staggered purchases rather than bulk buying. Augmont's Renisha Chainani expects silver to consolidate between $44 and $53 an ounce; the gold-silver ratio is around 82, up from about 46 at January's peak.

items.title: Gold (XAU/USD) Price Forecast: Breakdown Opens Door to $3,500
items.summary: Gold broke below October's swing low of $3,886 and fell to a new low of $3,720, and FXEmpire's technical analysis says the breakdown raises the chance of a test of major support near $3,500. Fibonacci retracements at $3,705 and $3,650 are the nearer levels to watch.

items.title: Festive gold sales value jumps 15-25 pc despite high prices: WGC
items.summary: Festive gold sales value rose 15-25% year-on-year over Dhanteras-Diwali, the World Gold Council said, while volumes were largely flat to slightly higher as average festive prices ran nearly 10% above last year. October gold imports were $5.51 billion, more than triple September's but 63% lower than a year earlier.

items.title: Gold price correction may support jewellery demand during India's wedding season: WGC
items.summary: The World Gold Council says lower gold prices and the ongoing wedding season should support jewellery demand in India, though a sharp rise could temper buying. Festive demand stayed healthy through Dhanteras and Diwali, with demand in value terms up 15-25% year on year. International gold fell 6.3% in October to $3,913 an ounce, and domestic gold has corrected more than 15% over three months.

items.title: $32 Billion Squeeze: Why India's Massive Gold Import Bill Is Shrinking Fast
items.summary: India's gold import bill could fall to $35-40 billion in FY27 from nearly $72 billion in FY26, NDTV Profit reports, with gold imports down about 40% to $24.78 billion in April-October. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal attributed the fall to the higher customs duty introduced in May, which made overseas purchases more expensive.

items.title: Gold Imports Triple In October To $5.51 Billion, But Remain Well Below Historical Levels
items.summary: India's gold imports more than tripled in October to $5.51 billion from September, but were 63% lower than a year earlier; the World Gold Council attributes the gap to unofficial supplies and recycled gold despite healthy Dhanteras-Diwali demand.

items.title: Gold imports may fall to $40 bn in FY27 on duty hike: Commerce Secy
items.summary: India's gold imports may fall to $40 billion in FY27 as the higher import duty curbs demand, the Commerce Secretary said, Business Standard reported. The May duty hike to 15% has already shrunk import volumes, easing pressure on the rupee and the trade deficit.

items.title: India Rupee Review: Steady as FII inflows offset importers' dollar demand
items.summary: The rupee ended broadly steady at 93.44 per dollar on Wednesday, after opening at 93.4050, as foreign institutional inflows offset dollar purchases by public-sector banks for importers. The currency had touched a seven-month high in early trade before giving back gains as the dollar strengthened. Dealers said RBI maturities in the non-deliverable forward market also weighed.

items.title: Central banks rethink gold as global risks mount
items.summary: Central banks are increasingly weighing geopolitical uncertainty alongside traditional financial risks when managing gold reserves, according to a new OMFIF report, while tokenization and retail investors reshape how gold is held and traded.

items.title: Gold, silver prices tumble to 1-year lows: What is driving the precious metals crash?
items.summary: Gold and silver tumbled to one-year lows, Fortune India reported, as a stronger dollar and expectations of further Fed rate hikes weighed on bullion. The selloff extends a slide that has taken spot gold to its lowest since September 2025.

items.title: SEBI revises minimum margin norms for commodity derivatives
items.summary: SEBI has revised minimum initial margins for commodity derivatives to 6% for low-volatility, 8% for medium and 10% for high-volatility contracts, applying uniformly to agricultural and non-agricultural commodities including bullion, with margin periods of risk of two to three days. The norms take effect on December 1, 2026 for one year.
